steps.en: Install the SDK and runtime package pair from local tarballs; npm publication hasn't happened yet
steps.zh: 从本地 tarball 装上 SDK 与运行时这一对包（npm 尚未发布）

steps.en: Run asset setup in your build and static-host the output on your own origin
steps.zh: 构建时跑一次资产装配，产物由你的站点静态托管

steps.en: Create a workspace session in your page code with the project files
steps.zh: 在页面代码里用项目文件建一个工作区会话

steps.en: A worker kernel boots inside the visitor's browser: virtual filesystem, QuickJS engine, WASM compilers
steps.zh: 访客浏览器里启动内核：虚拟文件系统、QuickJS、WASM 编译器

steps.en: Run project commands against that virtual filesystem
steps.zh: 对虚拟文件系统运行项目命令

steps.en: Executes the guest process in-tab and proxies its HTTP port into an isolated preview frame
steps.zh: 在标签页里跑起宿主进程，把它的端口代理进隔离预览框

steps.en: Snapshot the workspace to browser storage; resume replays it after a reload without reinstalling
steps.zh: 存档写进浏览器存储，重载后恢复，不用重装依赖

value.en: A real Vite or Start app runs, previews and resumes inside the browser tab — your server only serves static files
value.zh: 真实的 Vite 或 Start 应用在浏览器标签页里运行、预览、存档恢复——服务器只需托管静态文件

sources: examples/sdk-basic/README.md — tarball install (`npm install "$SDK_TARBALL" "$RUNTIME_TARBALL" --ignore-scripts`), run/save/reload/resume loop, Node host serves static files only
src/sdk/PACKAGES.md — `prepareRuntimeAssets('public/sandbox')`, assetBaseURL, owner origin vs separate preview origin, no postinstall download
examples/sdk-frameworks/README.md — Vite/Start install, run, preview, save to IndexedDB, resume without reinstall; separate loopback origins; compilation in browser workers
README.md — virtual filesystem, JavaScript processes, package installation, app previews, saved workspaces; not a complete Node.js or OS implementation
